package.description: Sync your Google Calendars and Contacts with Outlook

en-US.author: Scand Ltd.
en-US.description: Sync your Google Calendars and Contacts with Outlook
en-US.longDescription: Outlook4Gmail is an Outlook add-in that helps you sync Google and Outlook calendars, contacts, and tasks. It is a perfect syncing tool for Outlook users who have one or multiple Google accounts and need reliable Outlook Google Calendar sync for everyday work, planning, and collaboration, including one-way and two-way synchronization between Outlook and Google Calendar.
en-US.name: Outlook4Gmail

zh-CN.description: 将您的 Google 日历和联系人同步到 Outlook
zh-CN.longDescription: Outlook4Gmail 是一款 Outlook 加载项，可帮助你同步 Google 和 Outlook 的日历、联系人和任务。对于拥有一个或多个 Google 账户、且在日常工作、规划和协作中需要可靠的 Outlook Google 日历同步（包括 Outlook 与 Google 日历之间的单向和双向同步）的 Outlook 用户来说，它是一款完美的同步工具。
